Materialized and read full AQUINAS-ST-I-Q104-A1-EN and newly pinned complete author articles SCHMID-INERTIA-REPLY-3-ARTICLE (7 July 2021) and FESER-INERTIA-REPLY-2021-ARTICLE (6 July 2021), excluding reader comments. Exact paragraph locators, strongest responses and typed-interface inventory persist in docs/eternity-dependence-connection.md, Existential inertia section. Schmid accepts a PSR-like principle and proposes earlier existence plus absence of destructive causal change as extrinsic explanation without concurrent efficient sustenance; rejected treating this rival as merely brute persistence. Feser contests past-state sufficiency and alleges substance/persistence-power circularity; he expressly rejects annihilation/recreation conservation. Q104 objections and replies distinguish incorruptibility, completed production, preventing corruption and continuation of esse-giving without motion/time. Rejected identifying explanations with efficient causes, times with worlds, per-time causes with one fixed cause, or conditional typed correspondence with existence of a conserver. Existing direct essence-esse theorem yields double-negated identity only under its listed actual-target, no-support and interface/causal hypotheses; it does not defend conservation. No new shared vocabulary, Lean result, philosophical claim or root discharge is manufactured. Source assertions and this successful reading attempt do not establish target propositions. Actual necessary-support WF and cross-world union WF remain distinct open obligations. No new source reading claim, Lean result or root premise change. Added bounded analyst action candidates and finite controls in TruthCore/Causality/PreservationCandidates.lean; these are deliberately not declarations for the two original senses. Productive and interception roles belong to distinct episodes, not mutually exclusive agents. Occurrence, target identity and bearer presence omissions are tested. Concrete threat-set subtraction removes the addressed threat but retains other threats to the same bearer. Rejected treating constructor disjointness as an analysis of production, interception as successful prevention, set subtraction as causal stopping, or finite model roles as real conservation. Exact remaining formal-content gaps and root application plan persist in the two existing preservation definitions. Both sense allowances retained; no consequence or discharge registered. Bounded process follow-up (2026-11-09): new ProtectiveProcess model separates process identity, primitive occurrence edges, terminal destruction and bearer identity from set subtraction. Inductive finite-interval safety consumes initial presence, admissibility, represented-loss coverage and no bypass, each with an explicit body. Controls have a populated two-edge destruction, a shared-start interrupted/guarded trace, a direct bypass, later replacement, wrong-target removal and carrying premise omissions. Protection coexists with an entirely empty independent CausesIn relation. Rejected treating label deletion as process stopping; suppression of one process as protection against all processes; absence of represented destruction as survival without loss coverage; shared-start counterfactual difference as productive causation; or a sampled process model as timeless divine conservation. Realization-to-old-candidate projection is transcription. Original sourced declarations completed: zero; original allowances removed: zero. New conditional analyst process results do not establish original definitions or real-world applicability. Root audit found fd041f85 ActualEsseCausesSupportAt and 303d4ae5 not in the reaching-root set. The actual target for the connection plan is 732302a1 ParticipatedEsseHasDistinctCause, consumed by contingentGroundedViaParticipation on the root-reaching grounding route; the missing productive-receipt/interpretation bridge is recorded in per-accidens-preservation.json. New PreservationMeaning reuses the existing Exercise dictionary and supplies AvailableRecord, all-alternative SourceCut, nonvacuous PopulatedCut, SourceInactive and explicit RecordCovered. The cut theorem selects a contributor witness from every available record; source inactivity defeats available records, and effect loss follows only under separate allowed-scenario occurrence coverage. Alternative episodes sharing one source need not be individually required; splitting their bearer defeats the common-source cut. An enabler alone is not a contributor. The uncovered control retains an actual populated cut while effect occurrence persists with all source input absent, pinpointing the coverage gap. These are stipulated record semantics, not actual productive exercise, a complete inertial worldview, a nonexistence-to-cause criterion, or an interpretation of the bearer's esse. Rejected initially calling input availability productive realization: JointGroups explicitly separates exercise, positive productive interpretation and scenario occurrence. Rejected duplicating its contributor/alternative machinery or treating its sufficiency predicate as the same sense as its record container. The final batch selects only the record-container sense and adds no broad lexical senses. This describes root effects, not the value of the new library component. Shared import/status regeneration, independent semantic challenge of the final note/records and final integration CI remain coordinator-owned. No push, PR or watch.
blocker: The atemporal admitted-record dependency component is implemented; it does not analyze actual exercise or identify an effect token with this same bearer's esse. Next substantive application requires an independently described productive receipt record and a defense of occurrence coverage against the historical-law account; the current cut calculation alone cannot supply them. The existing illumination U/R/L candidate can calibrate input dependence but has illumination, not bare air existence, as its endpoint. Source inactivity is not source nonexistence or an asserted possible withdrawal. A SourceCut can fail on an admitted unrealizable alternative, so admission scope must also be justified. For original indirect preservation, physical/action-to-process realization and full interval scope remain open beyond ProtectiveProcess. Actual root-facing 732302a1 still requires a distinct productive CausesIn-at-esse witness; both original sourced declarations and allowances remain unchanged. Semantic review and final integration CI belong to the coordinator; no source acquisition is a prerequisite for the declared analyst logic.
